question: Within 80 kilometers, where can I find a fast food restaurant ahead of House Of Sports, Ardsley, NY toward Post University, Waterbury, CT?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.849839 41.012013)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.041211 41.554134)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.849839 41.012013)',4326)::geography, 80000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.849839 41.012013)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
